title: Arcángel & Bad Bunny’s ‘Me Acostumbré’ Surpasses 1 Billion Views on YouTube
summary: This marks Bad Bunny's 20th video to enter the Billion Views Club.
contentText:
Bad Bunny has locked in his 20th entry for YouTube’s Billion Views Club with the entry of “Me Acostumbré,” his collaboration on Arcángel’s trap banger released in 2017.

Published on Feb. 19, 2017, the music video surpassed the one billion mark, becoming Bunny’s 20th music video as a lead, featured artist or collaborator, and Arcángel’s seventh title. 

Produced by DJ Luian and Mambo Kingz, the collaboration is a hard-hitting trap song about someone who’s gotten used to winning all the time, and the fame and haters that comes with the success. Directed by Rodrigo Films in the Dominican Republic, the clip shows the two Puerto Rican stars enjoying the street life at night. 

The music video is the third visual that both Benito and Arcángel have together in the Billion Views Club, alongside “Tu No Vives Así” and “Diles.” It also enters the club after Bad Bunny’s dembow hit “Tití Me Preguntó” surpassed one billion views mark this January.

“Me Acostumbré” (which translates to “I got used to it”) became one of Benito’s early career titles on the Billboard charts when it peaked at No. 28 in Hot Latin Songs on the tally dated May 13, 2017.

The next Bunny music videos to potentially surpass 1 billion views with more than 800 million views at press time are “Sensualidad” with Prince Royce and J Balvin; “La Canción” with J Balvin; “Vuelve”; “Krippy Kush” with Farruko and Rvssian; and “Moscow Mule” off of his blockbuster 2022 album Un Verano Sin Ti.
